title: 9-Day Angkor Championship Golf & Song Saa Private Island Escape
description: Championship golf at Angkor paired with barefoot luxury at Song Saa Private Island. Play Faldo’s layout before retreating to an overwater villa.
destination: Siem Reap & Koh Rong Archipelago, Cambodia

signatureTour.title: The Indochina Golden Age
signatureTour.highlight: Upgrade to our grand 14-day Indochina signature tour connecting Song Saa with Vietnam’s premier coastal courses and heritage cities.

inclusions.detail: Private express speedboat transfer between Sihanoukville and Song Saa Private Island.
3 rounds at Angkor Golf Resort and Phokeethra Country Club in Siem Reap.
4 nights at Raffles Grand Hotel d'Angkor + 4 nights in an Overwater Villa at Song Saa Private Island.
All gourmet dining, sunset champagne, and water sports included at Song Saa.
Complete end-to-end management ensuring flawless transitions.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Siem Reap & Heritage Check-In at Raffles
itinerary.subtitle: Siem Reap Arrival
itinerary.imageCaption: Raffles Grand Hotel d'Angkor — Luxury Sanctuary Base
itinerary.imageAlt: Raffles Grand Hotel d'Angkor luxury accommodation Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Arrive in Siem Reap and transfer to Raffles Grand Hotel d'Angkor. Settle into your heritage room.

Enjoy welcome drinks in the Elephant Bar and an authentic royal Khmer welcome dinner.

itinerary.title: Faldo Mastery at Angkor Golf Resort
itinerary.subtitle: Round 1: Faldo Design Showcase
itinerary.imageCaption: Angkor Golf Resort Siem Reap — Sir Nick Faldo (Par 72, 7,000+ Yards)
itinerary.imageAlt: Angkor Golf Resort Siem Reap championship golf course Sir Nick Faldo Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Tee off at Angkor Golf Resort, navigating Sir Nick Faldo's strategic bunkering and contoured greens.

Return to Raffles for an afternoon swim in the historic pool.

itinerary.title: Angkor Wat Sunrise & Phokeethra Country Club
itinerary.subtitle: Round 2: Heritage & Golf
itinerary.imageCaption: Phokeethra Country Club — Weerayudth Phetbuasak (Par 72, 7,000+ Yards)
itinerary.imageAlt: Phokeethra Country Club championship golf course Weerayudth Phetbuasak Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Witness sunrise at Angkor Wat on a private scholar tour before playing Phokeethra Country Club.

Spend the evening exploring Siem Reap’s craft markets.

itinerary.title: Final Round at Angkor Golf Resort
itinerary.subtitle: Round 3: Championship Replay
itinerary.imageCaption: Angkor Golf Resort Siem Reap — Sir Nick Faldo (Par 72, 7,000+ Yards)
itinerary.imageAlt: Angkor Golf Resort Siem Reap championship golf course Sir Nick Faldo Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Play a final championship round at Angkor Golf Resort before heading to the coast.

Celebrate with drinks at the Elephant Bar.

itinerary.title: Speedboat Transit to Song Saa Private Island
itinerary.subtitle: Island Transition
itinerary.transferTime: Flight to Sihanoukville + 45 min private speedboat
itinerary.imageCaption: Song Saa Private Island — Luxury Sanctuary Base
itinerary.imageAlt: Song Saa Private Island luxury accommodation Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Fly to Sihanoukville and board a private express speedboat to Song Saa Private Island in the pristine Koh Rong Archipelago. Check into your Overwater Villa with direct ocean access.

Sip champagne on your private deck over the coral reef before dinner at Vista Bar and Restaurant.

itinerary.title: Overwater Villa Living & Coral Reef Snorkeling
itinerary.subtitle: Barefoot Luxury
itinerary.transferTime: At leisure on the private island
itinerary.imageCaption: Song Saa Private Island — Luxury Sanctuary Base
itinerary.imageAlt: Song Saa Private Island luxury accommodation Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Spend a day snorkeling over Song Saa's private marine reserve, paddleboarding, or swimming in your plunge pool.

Enjoy all-inclusive gourmet dining featuring fresh seafood and fine international wines.

itinerary.title: Holistic Island Spa & Biological Treatments
itinerary.subtitle: Island Restoration
itinerary.transferTime: At leisure on the private island
itinerary.imageCaption: Song Saa Private Island — Luxury Sanctuary Base
itinerary.imageAlt: Song Saa Private Island luxury accommodation Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Indulge in Song Saa Spa’s restorative biological treatments utilizing local herbs and marine elements.

Dine under the stars on the beach with barefoot island elegance.

itinerary.title: Private Sunset Champagne Cruise
itinerary.subtitle: Archipelago Exploration
itinerary.transferTime: At leisure on the private island
itinerary.imageCaption: Song Saa Private Island — Luxury Sanctuary Base
itinerary.imageAlt: Song Saa Private Island luxury accommodation Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Spend the afternoon sailing around the Koh Rong Archipelago on a private wooden boat, snorkeling in remote coves.

Enjoy a farewell sunset dinner with champagne on your villa deck.

itinerary.title: Speedboat Return & Airport Departure
itinerary.subtitle: Departure
itinerary.imageCaption: Song Saa Private Island — Luxury Sanctuary Base
itinerary.imageAlt: Song Saa Private Island luxury accommodation Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Enjoy a final breakfast over the water before your private speedboat return.

Your private executive transfer connects you to your onward flight, concluding an extraordinary golf and island escape.

faqs.question: What is included in Song Saa Private Island’s rate?
faqs.answer: Song Saa operates on an all-inclusive model featuring all à la carte gourmet meals, premium wines, minibar, and non-motorized water sports.
